title: Formal smoothness descends along etale maps of source and target for algebraic spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: In a commutative diagram of morphisms of algebraic spaces over S with etale vertical arrows U -> X and V -> Y, if f : X -> Y is formally smooth then psi : U -> V is formally smooth. The retained proof is a written three-lemma chain: the representability helper lemma makes U -> X and V -> Y formally etale, the composition lemma gives formal smoothness of U -> Y, and the formal permanence lemma descends smoothness to psi along the formally etale V -> Y. Retained author proof at lines 4567-4575.
